name: Wycheproof

source.verification: GitHub HTTPS commit archive (2026-11-15, main = 65ca494727a52944c204441c860b039e6786b99b). There are no releases, so it is pinned to a commit. There is no signature. Only the testvectors_v1 files used by the crypto module tests are imported (AEGIS is left out because Wycheproof uses a 128-bit tag, so tag and invalid cases cannot be verified with libsodium's 256-bit tag).

notes: Only 10 C1 crypto test files of testvectors_v1/, aes_cmac_test.json for C2, xchacha20_poly1305_secretstream_test.json for C3 (added 2026-11-15 after confirming the same archive SHA-256) and LICENSE were extracted byte for byte from the commit archive (Java and Go tools and other vectors are not kept). The Crypto tests (Crypto/Tests/WycheproofTests.cpp) read them with Core Json. Design: Docs/Design/Crypto.ko.md sections 5.4 and 12.
It is test data only and goes into no module binary, so it has no embeddedIn (the SDK need not distribute the license).

AEGIS vectors use a 128-bit tag, so tag and invalid cases cannot be verified with libsodium (256-bit tag), and they were not imported. The secretstream file (7 state vectors) runs in C3 by injecting state through a test access point.
